commands.command:
set -eu
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
cd "$wt"
printf 'ZOOM_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'ZOOM_SHA=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'ZOOM_DIRTY=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
cd frontend
node - <<'JS'
const fs=require('fs');
const {webkit}=require('@playwright/test');
const executable=webkit.executablePath();
console.log('WEBKIT_EXECUTABLE',executable);
console.log('WEBKIT_INSTALLED',fs.existsSync(executable));
JS
for p in 8000 5174 18080 15174; do
 if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$p" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -q LISTEN; then printf 'PORT_BUSY=%s\n' "$p"; else printf 'PORT_FREE=%s\n' "$p"; fi
done
echo PHOTOMAP_ZOOM_SAFARI_READINESS_READONLY
